plan.title: Open Participant Remarks for Live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses tab with the vendor bid already present.
Enable eRFX projects for the RFQ scenario.
Use the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Use the required bid-rejection configuration during bidding.
Enable buyer editing of bidding fields as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Verify that the Participant Remarks content or tab heading is rendered.
Verify that opening the tab did not produce an application error.
